channel.title: The Munsif Daily - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Munsif Daily (munsifdaily.com)

item.title: ‘Historical Hypocrisy’: Shiv Sena(UBT) in ‘Saamana’ criticises BJP amid Tipu Sultan row
item.description: The Shiv Sena Uddhav Balasaheb Thackeray on Monday entered the heated political fray over Tipu Sultan, unequivocally rejecting any comparison between the 18th-century Mysore ruler and Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj.

item.title: Alia Bhatt turns to ancient advice for modern motherhood
item.description: Bollywood star Alia Bhatt shared that she’s “obsessed” with reading about motherhood, posting a picture of a book that offers ancient advice for modern parents.

item.title: Sensex, Nifty trade nearly flat; IT index down 0.5 pc
item.description: The Indian equity markets opened the week almost flat with a mild negative bias on Monday, due to a weaker-than-expected earnings season and AI-led pressure on technology stocks.

item.title: Prakash Raj plays Ramanujam in Varalaxmi Sarathkumar’s ‘Saraswathi’
item.description: The makers of 'Saraswathi', which marks actress Varalaxmi Sarathkumar's debut as a director in the film industry, have now released the first look of actor Prakash Raj's character in the film and disclosed that he plays a lawyer called Ramanujam in the film.

item.title: Hyderabad: 63 Police Inspectors Transferred in Administrative Reshuffle
item.description: According to the official orders, several officers who were serving in the Special Branch have been reassigned as Station House Officers (SHOs) at various police stations across the city.

item.title: FM Sitharaman to bolster economic ties with Norway, meet CEOs and investors
item.description: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman was set to meet Jonas Ghar Store, Prime Minister of Norway, and hold bilateral meetings with Norwegian Finance Minister Jens Stoltenberg along with Minister for Trade and Industry, Cecilie Myrseth, it was announced on Monday.

item.title: Lalu, Rabri plead innocence, opt to face trial in land-for-job case
item.description: Rashtriya Janata Dal (RJD) chief Lalu Prasad Yadav and former Bihar Chief Minister Rabri Devi on Monday pleaded innocence in the alleged Railways land-for-jobs corruption case being probed by the Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) and expressed their willingness to face trial.

item.title: More senior Congress leaders set to quit party: Assam CM Sarma
item.description: Assam Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma on Monday claimed that more senior Congress leaders are set to quit the party following the resignation of Bhupen Borah, asserting that the grand old party has lost its relevance for both Hindus and common Assamese people.

item.title: Hyderabad Erupts in Celebration After India’s Victory Over Pakistan in T20 World Cup League Match
item.description: Soon after the match concluded on Sunday night, groups of enthusiastic youngsters gathered at various junctions and prominent locations across the city to celebrate the win. Fireworks lit up the night sky as fans distributed sweets and congratulated one another.

item.title: NPCI extends ‘UPI One World’ wallet for foreign delegates at India AI Impact Summit 2026
item.description: The National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI) on Monday announced that it has extended its ‘UPI One World’ wallet service for international visitors attending the India AI Impact Summit 2026 in the national capital.
